method: If you have five minutes, brown the lean pork loin in a properly hot pan first. It is optional, but that bit of colour gives the finished dish far more depth.
Put the vegetables, measured cooking liquid and lean pork loin into the slow cooker. Stir once so everything is coated, then cook on LOW for 6–8 hours or HIGH for 3–4 hours.

Keep the lid on while it cooks. In the final 30 minutes, check the texture: if the cooking liquid is still thin, leave the lid slightly ajar or finish uncovered where your cooker allows until it reduces.
Check the lean pork loin is safely cooked, taste the finished dish and adjust the seasoning before serving. Cool leftovers quickly and refrigerate.
